question: Who broke her own pole vault National record of 4.20 m to set a new record of 4.21 m at the National Open Athletics Championships in October 2022 at Bengaluru?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rosy Meena Paulraj.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rosy Meena Paulraj** broke her own pole vault National record of 4.20 m to set a new record of** 4.21 m** at the **National Open Athletics Championships** in October 2022 at **Bengaluru.**
 
• Rosy Meena Paulraj is a professional **pole vaulter **from **Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• Pole vaulting is a track and field event in which a person uses a** long, flexible pole** to jump over a bar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahi Patel** is a **long-distance runner** from **Gujarat, India.**
 
• **Pavithra Venkatesh **is a** pole vaulter** from** Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
 
• At the **60th National Open athletics meet,** Pavithra Venkatesh took home the **gold **in the women's pole vault competition.
 
 
 
• **VS Surekha** is a pole vaulter from India.
 
 
• She currently owns the **4.15 m national mark**, which was established in 2014 at the** National Open Championships** in New Delhi.
